### Run project

```{r}
# Create results folder
output_dir <- "../results"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir))
  dir.create(output_dir)

# Run and render project
files <- c("01_load.qmd", "02_clean.qmd", "03_augment.qmd",
           "04_describe.qmd", "05_analysis_1.qmd")

files |> walk(
  quarto::quarto_render,
  quarto_args = c("--output-dir", output_dir))
```
